newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU vets SNECMA/Pratt & Whitney engine venture.
newsitem.headline: EU vets SNECMA/Pratt & Whitney engine venture.

text.p: The European Commission said on Tuesday it was probing a proposed joint venture between France's Societe Nationale d'Etude et de Construction de Moteurs d'Aviation (SNECMA) and Pratt & Whitney Canada.

The deal aims at developing, producing and marketing a new turbofan engine in the 12,000-16,000 pounds thrust class to power 58-90 seat regional jet aircraft, the Commission said in a a statement to be published in the EU's Official Journal.

It noted that the venture would enable the companies to respond to a tender issued by Aerospatiale SNI for a propulsion system for a new family of regional jets being contemplated by European aircraft manufacturer Aero International Regional.
The Commission said that the agreement apparently fell under EU regulation 17/62. There is no deadline for it to rule on cases falling under such rules.
It invited third parties to give their views.
